ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Script With File Hostname Resolving Capabilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell scripts that have capabilities to read files, loop through them and resolve DNS host entries. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-content\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*foreach.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Net\\\.Dns\\]\\:\\:GetHostEntry.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Out\\-File.*"))
